about_the_game:
Story:

The chemists didn't stop to think about whether they should; they just knew they could, so they did.

They developed a toothpaste so minty it came to life and invaded the island.

The lucky ones were able to flee; the rest of us stayed in our shelters and tried to survive, waiting for help that might never come.

Now it's up to you to SURVIVE AS LONG AS YOU CAN without dying of hunger, thirst, or injury.

Shelter:

You can store plenty of supplies in your shelter to relieve your thirst and hunger.

Carefully manage your inventory and keep your weapons ready, your lights on batteries, and your generator fueled.

Occasionally, a slime will sneak into your base.

And each cycle, the great wave of enemies will test your supply capacity.

Travel:

When you run out of supplies, you'll be forced to loot locations on the island.

Each location has specific loot, and you'll need to decide what you need on each trip.

Each time you explore a location, it will become harder to loot the next time, and enemies will be more active.

The journey will take time, and you'll need to plan what supplies you carry in your backpack.

Explore:

Exploration is done with a color-matching game, but with a twist.

You can rotate the board and all the items on the board will fall down.

The number of crates you break will reveal items you'll have to reach for.

But each hit is a noise that attracts enemies. They will appear on the board and attack you based on their size.

Be careful, enemies merge to become larger and more dangerous.

You can defend yourself, but weapons also make noise and have a limited range.

When your backpack is full, you'll have to decide whether to drop something on the ground in case you want it later,

throw it in the trash and lose it forever, or return to your safe house to drop all your loot.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: 2.5Ghz or better
  • Memory: 500 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 180 MB available space

short_description: A game where you try to avoid hunger, thirst, and injury for as long as you can. You search for loot in different locations using a color-matching game with a twist, and you manage your inventory to always have enough supplies.
